_signals.x_guidance:
Loyal Spark on Base L2 (chain 8453, USDC native).

Auth modes:
• Merchant agents — header x-api-key: lsk_... (or Authorization: Bearer lsk_...). Get a key in https://loyalspark.online/merchant → AI Agents.
• Holder agents — header x-api-key: rwk_... (or Authorization: Bearer rwk_...). Issued via SIWE: https://loyalspark.online/.well-known/agent.json.
• x402 corridor — pay USDC on Base per call. Discovery: https://loyalspark.online/.well-known/x402.

Typical merchant flow:
1. GET /me — profile and scopes
2. POST /programs — factory calldata to deploy ERC-20
3. POST /register-program — persist program
4. POST /update-program-config — set cashback_rate / points_per_dollar
5. POST /activate-program — unpause
6. POST /mint or POST /earn — distribute points
7. POST /rewards — catalog
8. GET /analytics — metrics

MCP mirrors REST: 32 merchant tools at https://api.loyalspark.online/loyalty-mcp and 14 recipient tools at https://api.loyalspark.online/recipient-loyalty-mcp. Each MCP tool also has a paid x402 path under /x402-gateway/mcp-tools/<name> and /x402-gateway/recipient-mcp-tools/<name>.

Docs: https://loyalspark.online/api-docs · llms: https://loyalspark.online/llms.txt · agent manifest: https://loyalspark.online/.well-known/agent.json
